syncContent.coreHelp: Native transactions, payment links, accounting controls and their required master data stay together.
syncContent.unavailableHelp: This connector does not currently expose this population.
syncContent.preservesData: Turning content off preserves imported data. Re-enabling it catches up the supported population on the next sync. Organization feature permissions still apply.
syncContent.help: Choose the additional content included in manual and scheduled syncs.

hints.attachments: Imports files attached to transactions, including vendor bill PDFs and expense receipts. Enabling this catches up previously synced transactions; later runs add new files and versions without duplicate files.
hints.projectFinancials: Reconcile project commercial data and time-entry billing states.
hints.crm: Import supported opportunities, activities and customer relationship records when CRM is enabled.
hints.fixedAssets: Import the supported asset register and source history when Fixed Assets is enabled.

mappings.automatic: This connector maps its supported records automatically and exposes no custom field overrides.
mappings.unreadable: Saved mappings cannot be read. Reset them only if you intend to replace the existing overrides.
mappings.unsupported: These saved mappings are unsupported. Remove them or use a connector version that supports them before saving.
mappings.childHelp: Field on the source record configured in {parent}.
mappings.valueRequired: Choose a unique source value and its target before adding.
mappings.finishDraft: Finish or discard each unfinished value mapping before saving.
mappings.resetConfirm: Reset all saved field mappings for this connection? Existing imported records are preserved.
mappings.help: Standard mappings are automatic. Add only the source-specific overrides you need; choose a resource, then its fields or value mappings.
mappings.nativeRecords: Accounts, items, entities and their references are matched automatically by source identity. These optional mappings select custom source fields and translate source values.
mappings.saveFirst: Save the connection first, then reopen Mappings to choose fields from the source.
mappings.choicesFailed: Could not load source choices. Check the connection and its read permissions, then retry.
mappings.parentChangeConfirm: Changing the source record clears its child-field override. Continue?

postedChanges.label: Changes to posted source transactions
postedChanges.help: Automatic corrections never rewrite posted history. OpenBooks retains the original, posts a linked reversal and replacement, transfers eligible applications, and still stops for reconciliations, closed periods, inventory, revenue recognition, or downstream documents.

drawer.structuredRequired: This setting needs a structured editor. Update the connector configuration before editing it.

entityMappings.help: Choose an entity, then add field mappings, value translations or explicit defaults. Unmapped fields keep the connector’s standard behavior.
entityMappings.metadataFailed: Mapping metadata is unavailable. Check source read access and retry.
entityMappings.invalid: Complete the mapping with supported fields and values.
entityMappings.saveFirst: Save the connection first to load its source and native fields.
entityMappings.standard: No overrides. This entity uses the standard connector mappings.
entityMappings.sourceHelp: Choose a field exposed by this connector. Custom source fields require source read permission.
entityMappings.targetHelp: Choose a native field or an active custom field. Sync retains native validation and permissions.
entityMappings.missingHelp: Choose what happens when a source field is empty or a value translation has no match. Refusal stops the record; keeping preserves the standard mapping.
entityMappings.defaultHelp: A default is used only by the selected missing-value policy, or when no source field is selected.
entityMappings.valuesHelp: Translate individual source values. Source values must be unique. Native values must match the chosen field’s type.
entityMappings.protectedFields: Source identities, posted amounts and governed lifecycle fields keep their native controls. Define custom fields in Setup to offer additional native targets.
entityMappings.unavailableRulesHelp: These saved rules are read-only because this connector cannot apply them. Their original values are preserved. Remove each rule explicitly before saving; valid rules remain in the structured controls.

netsuite.setupHint: Install the read-only RESTlet and Map/Reduce bundle, then test this connection. No script is attached to transaction records.

qbd.setupHint: After saving, download the Web Connector file from the connection card. Import it on the Windows computer running QuickBooks, approve read-only access as the QuickBooks administrator, and enter this password in Web Connector.
qbd.notConnected: Web Connector has not connected yet
qbd.qwcDescription: Read-only accounting migration and reconciliation connector

netsuite.blurb: Install the read-only extraction bridge, then connect with a dedicated token-based role. Transactions, applications, accounting controls and deletions are mirrored through proof-gated imports.

mappingJson.label: Custom field and value mappings
mappingJson.help: Choose custom fields and value mappings in the Mappings tab.

odoo.blurb: Connect with your Odoo URL, database, user and an API key (Settings → My Profile → Account Security → API Keys). Invoices, bills, payments and journals migrate and mirror natively through the real posting engine.

erpnext.blurb: Connect with your ERPNext URL and an API key + secret (User → Settings → API Access). Invoices, bills, payment entries and journals migrate and mirror natively through the real posting engine.

qbd.blurb: Connect QuickBooks Desktop through Intuit's Web Connector. QuickBooks must be open for the one-time authorization and while captures run; no inbound Windows firewall rule is required.

historyStartDate.label: History start date
historyStartDate.help: The earliest posting date to migrate. Each mirror rechecks this complete range so historical edits and deletions are detected.

companyFile.label: Company file path (optional)
companyFile.help: Leave blank to use whichever company is open when Web Connector runs.

webConnectorPassword.label: Web Connector password
webConnectorPassword.help: Enter this password once in QuickBooks Web Connector after importing the .QWC file.

qbo.blurb: Enter your Intuit app's Client ID + Secret (developer.intuit.com → Keys & credentials), save, then click Connect to authorize a company. Invoices, bills, payments, credits, journals and deposits migrate and mirror natively.
steps: Create an app (QuickBooks Online and Payments) with the com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting scope.
Under Keys & credentials, add the Redirect URI shown below (use Development keys for a sandbox company, Production keys for a live one).
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret into this form, save, then click Connect.

xero.blurb: Enter your Xero app's Client ID + Secret (developer.xero.com → My Apps), save, then click Connect to authorize an organisation. Invoices, bills, credit notes, payments, journals and bank transactions migrate and mirror natively.
steps: Create a new app (integration type: Web app); the company URL can be this site's address.
Add the Redirect URI shown below to the app's OAuth 2.0 redirect URIs.
Copy the Client ID, generate a Client Secret, paste both into this form, save, then click Connect.

migrationAssistant.title: Migration assistant
migrationAssistant.placeholder: Tell me where your books live today, or drop an export file…

cutover.title: Move your books
cutover.description: Bring your balances, open invoices and bills, assets, and bank starting points across step by step, in any order. Nothing here needs the AI assistant.
cutover.anyOrder: Work the steps in any order, and skip what does not apply — only go-live checks its requirements.

helper.title: Want help with the move?
helper.description: The migration assistant answers questions about your books and drafts the same entries and imports this page describes. Nothing changes until you approve it.

setup.title: Your move
setup.description: How your books arrive, and the date that separates the old books from these.

paths.cutover: From a connected system, then cut over

setup.pathHint: Spreadsheets suit manual books. A connected system migrates through Migration & Sync.
setup.cutoverDateHint: First day kept in these books rather than the previous system.
setup.clearingHint: Open invoices, bills, and the trial balance offset here until both sides tie out. Optional.
setup.connector: This path loads on Migration & Sync — connect the source, rehearse, and load history there, then return here for the final checks.

plan.title: Choose how the books arrive
plan.description: Pick the spreadsheet path above, or connect the previous system.

cutoverDate.title: Set the cutover date
cutoverDate.description: The first day kept in these books. Opening balances are dated the day before.

opening.title: Post the opening trial balance
opening.description: From the staged trial balance below: a balanced native journal dated the day before cutover. An unbalanced file is refused, never plugged.

receivables.title: Import open customer invoices
receivables.description: Unpaid invoices as of cutover, with original dates and due dates, coded to the clearing account. Pick the customer invoices template on Import.

payables.title: Import open vendor bills
payables.description: Unpaid bills as of cutover, with original dates and due dates, coded to the clearing account. Pick the vendor bills template on Import.

assets.title: Import fixed assets
assets.description: Each asset with its cost, in-service date, and accumulated depreciation as of cutover. Pick the fixed assets template on Import.

bank.title: Set bank starting points
bank.description: Bank balances arrive with the opening trial balance. Then import the first statement and start the first reconciliation, which proves the opening.

checks.title: Run the final checks and go live
checks.description: Every required check must pass before these books go live from the cutover date.

welcome.title: Let’s move your books in
welcome.description: Tell me what you use today. I’ll set up the connection or the spreadsheet imports, rehearse the move, verify every balance against your previous system, and take you through cutover. You approve every change.
welcome.fromWizard: You told the setup wizard you’re bringing existing books. Pick how they should arrive.
welcome.dropHint: Drop a CSV or Excel export into the conversation at any time.

unsure.label: Not sure? Help me choose
unsure.prompt: I’m not sure which migration approach fits us. Ask me what you need to know and recommend one.

cutover.title: Switch over on a cutover date
cutover.description: Migrate history through a connector, verify it to the cent, then go live.
cutover.prompt: We want to switch to OpenBooks completely on a cutover date. Walk me through the migration.

mirror.title: Mirror my current system
mirror.description: Keep these books synchronized with the system you use now while you evaluate or run in parallel.
mirror.prompt: I’d like to mirror our current accounting system into OpenBooks while we evaluate. Help me set it up.

spreadsheet.title: Bring my data from spreadsheets
spreadsheet.description: For any system: export your lists and balances, and I’ll map, validate and import them.
spreadsheet.prompt: Our current system has no connector. Help me migrate from spreadsheet exports.

fresh.title: Start fresh
fresh.description: No history to bring. Set up the foundation and opening balances, then go live.
